theme: Generalized extreme and recency-of-extreme breakouts — HighestIndex/LowestIndex bars-since, and Highest/Lowest on alternate source series.

specs.name: FreshNbarHigh
specs.rule: Long when HighestIndex(High,N) == 0 — price just printed a fresh N-bar high on the confirmed bar
specs.hypothesis: A bar printing the highest high of the prior N bars is followed by positive forward 1-10 bar returns (mirror for fresh lows on the short side).
specs.economic_rationale: Donchian/Turtle: a new extreme triggers breakout-momentum order flow and pending-order cascades just beyond the prior edge.
specs.orthogonality: HighestIndex is ignoreInBuilder — the random builder can NEVER generate this. Measures RECENCY of the extreme as an index, not a price comparison; fires on the bar the extreme is set.
specs.source: Faith, Way of the Turtle (2007); Donchian breakout.
specs.notes: #ComputedFrom#=High(2) for long / Low(3) for short. #Shift#=1. Number=1 → HighestIndex returns 0 on a fresh high. Short side swaps atom to LowestIndex.

specs.name: StaleHighExhaustion
specs.rule: Gate: HighestIndex(High,N) >= k — many bars since the last N-bar high (up-leg gone stale)
specs.hypothesis: When many bars have elapsed since the last N-bar high, the probability the up-trend continues falls vs a market still making fresh highs.
specs.economic_rationale: Trend momentum decays with time-since-extreme; failure to make a new high signals exhausted breakout flow. A conditioning gate, not a directional trigger.
specs.orthogonality: Pure time-since-extreme; no other catalog atom expresses 'how long since the high'. Orthogonal to oscillator-OB (ignores indicator level, looks only at extreme recency).
specs.notes: #ComputedFrom#=High for stale-high, Low for mirror. Regime GATE — pair with an entry, do not trade standalone. #Shift#=1.

specs.name: RobustNbarHighBreak
specs.rule: Long when Close > Highest(High,N) read at shift 1 (one-bar-excluded channel top = spike-tolerant break)
specs.hypothesis: Breaking a level that excludes the live spike produces fewer false-break entries than breaking the absolute extreme; better forward returns net of whipsaw.
specs.economic_rationale: A single wick sets an unrepresentative channel top; a slightly-inside level filters liquidity-grab spikes.
specs.orthogonality: Approximates an Nth-highest robust level. IndicatorHighest #NthValue# is NOT in this catalog, so true 2nd-highest is emulated by the shift-1 channel top (structurally excludes the current spike).
specs.notes: PARTIAL proxy for 'ignore one spike' — flag for critic. May duplicate DonchianHighPierceUpper; the distinction is Close vs High on the left side.

specs.name: ClosingBreakoutChannel
specs.rule: Long when Close exceeds the highest Close of the prior N bars (closing-basis Donchian, #ComputedFrom#=Close)
specs.hypothesis: Closing-price channel breakouts have a higher continuation rate than intrabar high breakouts — a close beyond the range reflects committed positioning.
specs.economic_rationale: Settlement commitment: a sustained close beyond the range traps faders and confirms the break with less noise than an intrabar poke.
specs.orthogonality: Highest #ComputedFrom#=Close (close-channel) — distinct from High-based Donchian by which series defines the level.
specs.source: Closing-price Donchian variants; systematic trend literature.
specs.notes: Highest #ComputedFrom#=Close(0), #Shift#=1. Left atom = current Close. Short mirror uses Lowest #ComputedFrom#=Close.

specs.name: MomentumThrustFreshHigh
specs.rule: Long when HighestIndex(High, short-N) == 0 — a fresh SHORT-window high = momentum thrust
specs.hypothesis: A fresh short-window (~10-bar) high marks an acceleration/thrust point; forward 1-5 bar returns are positive before momentum decays.
specs.economic_rationale: Short-horizon breakout = momentum thrust: the asset moves faster than its recent range, attracting trend-followers and squeezing shorts.
specs.orthogonality: Same HighestIndex==0 mechanic as FreshNbarHigh but at a SHORT window — captures thrust not range breakout (different horizon). NOTE: true 'highest ROC/RSI in N' NOT buildable (IndicatorHighest absent) — this is the price-high thrust fallback.
specs.notes: Risk: largely overlaps FreshNbarHigh (only #Period# range differs). #ComputedFrom#=High, #Shift#=1.

specs.name: FailedHighReversal
specs.rule: Short when Close < Highest(High,N)[shift1] after a recent extreme (failed-breakout fade, single-signal form)
specs.hypothesis: A close back inside the prior N-bar range after a recent extreme signals a failed breakout / liquidity sweep; forward returns mean-revert.
specs.economic_rationale: Stop-run: price pokes the prior high to trigger breakout buyers and stops, then reverses; reclaim from above is the fade.
specs.orthogonality: Reversal using the same Highest level but opposite comparison. NOTE: likely duplicates FailedHighBreakFade (that uses crosses_below; this uses is_lower state) — critic should consolidate.
specs.notes: is_lower is a STATE not the cross event — higher false-positive rate than FailedHighBreakFade's crosses_below. Flag for critic.

specs.name: DualSideNoExtreme
specs.rule: Coil gate: HighestIndex(High,N) >= k AND LowestIndex(Low,N) >= k — no fresh high or low recently
specs.hypothesis: When both the N-bar high and low are several bars old, realised range is contracting and the subsequent breakout (either direction) is larger than baseline.
specs.economic_rationale: Vol clustering / squeeze: an interval with no new extreme on either side is a contraction phase, and contraction precedes expansion (NR-type).
specs.orthogonality: Genuine conjunction — 'no extreme on EITHER side' is inherently HighestIndex>=k AND LowestIndex>=k. Both ignoreInBuilder → unreachable by the random builder. A pure price-extreme-recency squeeze, complementing TTMSqueeze/BBWidthRatio.
specs.notes: Symmetric (CBlock_null) GATE. Both at #Shift#=1. If critic dislikes the AND, split into two single-side staleness gates.

specs.name: PriorPeriodHighBreak
specs.rule: Long when Close > Highest(High,N)[shift1] — canonical upper-Donchian baseline
specs.hypothesis: Close above the prior N-bar high (classic upper Donchian) is followed by positive forward returns in trending instruments — the canonical baseline.
specs.economic_rationale: Range-break order flow: breakout orders and trend-follower entries cluster just beyond the prior N-bar high.
specs.orthogonality: NOTE: this is essentially identical to DonchianCloseBreakUpper (Close vs Highest(High)[1]) except is_greater (state) vs crosses_above (event). Critic should KEEP only one.
specs.notes: Highest #ComputedFrom#=High, #Shift#=1. Redundant with DonchianCloseBreakUpper — keep the cross version, drop this, OR keep this as the 'state' filter variant.
